0022600211.text: The Milwaukee Bucks, 1-9 overall and 0-4 on the road, head to New York on a six-game losing streak, sitting 15th in the East, while the Knicks (5-4) are on a three-game winning streak and 5th in the East. Bucks guard Tyler Herro (knee bruise) and forward Kel'el Ware (ankle sprain) are both day-to-day with game-time decisions, and Knicks forward Josh Hart is also a game-time decision with an illness. The teams have not played yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Bucks lost 1-2 to New York in 2025-26, including a 127-98 loss in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
